blocks.text: Present Perfect — o'tmishni hozirga bog'laydigan zamon

Present Perfect (hozirgi tugallangan zamon) — **have / has + V3**. Shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 15–17-darslar). Mohiyati: harakat o'tmishda bo'lgan, lekin gap **hozir** haqida — o'sha harakatning hozirgi natijasi yoki ahamiyati haqida. I**'ve lost** my wallet — hamyonim **hozir yo'q**. Shuning uchun harakat **qachon** bo'lgani muhim emas va aytilmaydi. Vaqt aytilsa (yesterday, in 2020), Past Simple kerak bo'ladi (→ 5-dars).

O'zbekchada Present Perfect degan alohida zamon yo'q. Uning ma'nosi bir necha shakl bilan beriladi, va aksincha — o'zbekcha «**-di**» ba'zan Present Perfect, ba'zan Past Simple bo'ladi. Shuning uchun tarjima qilganda shaklga emas, **ma'noga** qarang: gap hozirgi holat haqidami yoki o'tmishdagi aniq vaqt haqidami?

Present Perfect ning eng muhim ishi — hozirgi holatni o'tmishdagi harakat orqali tushuntirish. Biror narsa yo'q, singan, tayyor, o'zgargan, ko'tarilgan — va buning sababi yaqinda bo'lgan harakat. Agar natija endi yo'q bo'lsa (kalitni yo'qotgan edim, keyin topdim) yoki gap tugagan voqea tafsiloti haqida bo'lsa — Past Simple (→ 13-dars).

items.text: I**'ve cut** my finger — have you got a plaster?
The lift **has broken down**, so we'll have to walk up.
items.translation: Lift **buzilib qoldi**, piyoda chiqishimizga to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: Bekzod **has grown** a beard — I almost didn't recognise him.
items.translation: Bekzod **soqol qo'yibdi** — uni tanimay qolishimga sal qoldi.

blocks.text: Yangilikni birinchi marta xabar qilganda Present Perfect ishlatiladi: The government **has raised** taxes. Gap tafsilotlarga — qachon, qayerda, qanday — o'tganda esa Past Simple ga o'tiladi: It **announced** the decision yesterday. Yangiliklar sarlavhasi va matnining birinchi gapi ko'pincha shunday quriladi. O'zbekchada yangilik ko'pincha «**-ibdi**» bilan beriladi: Jasur uy **sotib olibdi**!

items.text: The government **has raised** the minimum wage. It **announced** the decision yesterday.
items.translation: Hukumat eng kam ish haqini **oshirdi**. Bu qarorni kecha **e'lon qildi**.

items.text: Have you heard? Jasur **has bought** a house in the mountains!

rows: have va V3 orasida yoki gap oxirida

items.text: The meeting **has just started**, so you can still go in.
We**'ve already ordered** — sorry we didn't wait for you.
items.translation: Biz **allaqachon buyurtma berdik** — sizni kutmaganimiz uchun uzr.

items.text: **Has** the post **come** yet? I'm expecting a letter from the bank.

blocks.text: **has gone to** — ketgan va hozir **o'sha yerda** (bu yerda yo'q): Sarah **has gone** to Paris — Sara Parijga ketgan. **has been to** — borgan va **qaytib kelgan**: Sarah **has been** to Paris — Sara Parijga borib kelgan (yoki: Parijda bo'lgan). O'zbekchada farq «**ketdi / ketgan**» va «**borib keldi / bo'lgan**» orqali beriladi. been — hayot tajribasi ma'nosida ham keladi (→ 8-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have lost my key yesterday.» → I **lost** my key yesterday. (aniq vaqt bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi, → 14-dars); «She has went.» → She has **gone**. (V2 emas, V3); «I didn't finish yet.» → I **haven't finished** yet. (British English); «He has been to London» — u hali Londonda bo'lsa → He**'s gone** to London.; «When have you arrived?» → When **did** you **arrive**? (when — doim Past Simple); «I have just now finished.» → I**'ve just finished.** / I finished just now.

Gapni «...va shuning uchun **hozir** ...» deb davom ettira olasizmi? «Kalitimni yo'qotdim — va shuning uchun hozir uyga kira olmayman.» Ha bo'lsa va vaqt aytilmagan bo'lsa — Present Perfect. «Qachon?» degan savolga aniq javob bo'lsa — Past Simple.

Amerika ingliz tilida just / already / yet bilan Past Simple ham keng tarqalgan (Did you eat yet?). Bizning kitob British English ga tayanadi. Hayot tajribasi (ever, never) va tugamagan davr (today, this week) → 8-dars; have been doing → 9-dars; Past Simple bilan farqi → 13–14-darslar.

rows: He**'s gone** to Bukhara. (u yerda) He**'s been** to Bukhara. (qaytgan)

examples.title: Past action, present result
examples.description: Harakat o'tmishda bo'ldi, lekin gap uning hozirgi natijasi haqida: narsa yo'q, singan, tayyor, o'zgargan. Vaqt aytilmaydi.

sentences.text: I**'ve lost** my wallet, so I can't pay for the taxi.
sentences.translation: Hamyonimni **yo'qotib qo'ydim**, shuning uchun taksiga to'lay olmayman.

sentences.text: Someone **has parked** in front of our gate, and I can't get the car out.
sentences.translation: Kimdir darvozamiz oldiga mashina **qo'yib ketibdi**, mashinamni chiqara olmayapman.

sentences.text: Look, the river **has risen** — the path along the bank is under water.
sentences.translation: Qara, daryo suvi **ko'tarilibdi** — qirg'oq bo'yidagi yo'lak suv ostida qolibdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has broken** his leg, so he won't play in the final.
sentences.translation: Bekzod oyog'ini **sindirib oldi**, shuning uchun finalda o'ynamaydi.

sentences.text: The price of petrol **has gone up** again — it's almost double now.
sentences.translation: Benzin narxi yana **oshibdi** — hozir deyarli ikki baravar qimmat.

sentences.text: **Have** you **cut** your hair? It looks really good.
sentences.translation: Sochingizni **oldirdingizmi**? Juda chiroyli ko'rinyapti.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **have painted** their house bright yellow, and the whole street is talking about it.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz uyini yorqin sariq rangga **bo'yashibdi**, butun ko'cha shu haqda gapiryapti.

sentences.text: My laptop **has stopped** working, and I have a presentation tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Noutbukim **ishlamay qoldi**, ertaga esa taqdimotim bor.

sentences.text: The company **has moved** its office to a new building near the metro.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya ofisini metro yaqinidagi yangi binoga **ko'chirdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **has forgotten** his password, so he can't log in to the system.
sentences.translation: Jasur parolini **unutib qo'ydi**, shuning uchun tizimga kira olmayapti.

examples.title: Giving news: **has won**, **have announced**
examples.description: Yangilik xabar qilish — Present Perfect; tafsilotlar (qachon, qayerda) esa Past Simple bilan (→ 13-dars). O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-ibdi».

sentences.text: Guess what? Madina **has won** a scholarship to study in Edinburgh!
sentences.translation: Bilasanmi? Madina Edinburgda o'qish uchun **grant yutibdi**!

sentences.text: Scientists **have discovered** a new species of lizard in the Kyzylkum Desert.
sentences.translation: Olimlar Qizilqum cho'lida kaltakesakning yangi turini **kashf etishdi**.

sentences.text: The city council **has decided** to close the old market for repairs.
sentences.translation: Shahar kengashi eski bozorni ta'mirlash uchun yopishga **qaror qildi**.

sentences.text: Have you heard? Oliver and Kate **have split up**.
sentences.translation: Eshitdingmi? Oliver bilan Keyt **ajrashib ketishibdi**.

sentences.text: The airline **has cancelled** all flights to London because of the fog.
sentences.translation: Tuman sababli aviakompaniya Londonga barcha reyslarni **bekor qildi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **has opened** a coffee shop near the university. He **opened** it last Monday.
sentences.translation: Aziz universitet yonida qahvaxona **ochibdi**. O'tgan dushanba kuni **ochgan** ekan.

sentences.text: Prices in the shops **have risen** by ten per cent, according to the latest report.
sentences.translation: So'nggi hisobotga ko'ra, do'konlardagi narxlar o'n foizga **oshdi**.

sentences.text: Great news — Tom **has passed** all his exams, so he's going to university!
sentences.translation: Ajoyib yangilik — Tom barcha imtihonlarini **topshiribdi**, demak, universitetga kiradi!

sentences.text: The police **have arrested** two men after the robbery in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazidagi o'g'irlikdan keyin politsiya ikki kishini **qo'lga oldi**.

sentences.text: Someone **has left** a bag on the bus — does it belong to anybody here?
sentences.translation: Kimdir avtobusda sumka **qoldirib ketibdi** — bu yerdagi birortangiznikimi?

examples.title: **just**: a moment ago
examples.description: just — hozirgina, endigina: have / has + just + V3. O'zbekchada «hozirgina», «endigina ... -di».

sentences.text: I**'ve just finished** the report — shall I send it to you now?
sentences.translation: Hisobotni **hozirgina tugatdim** — hozir sizga yuboraymi?

sentences.text: Sorry, Nilufar **has just gone** out. Can I take a message?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Nilufar **hozirgina chiqib ketdi**. Unga biror narsa aytib qo'yaymi?

sentences.text: The train **has just left**, so we'll have to wait an hour for the next one.
sentences.translation: Poyezd **hozirgina jo'nab ketdi**, keyingisini bir soat kutishimizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: We**'ve just heard** the news about your promotion — congratulations!
sentences.translation: Lavozimingiz oshgani haqidagi xabarni **endigina eshitdik** — tabriklaymiz!

sentences.text: Don't touch the door — I**'ve just painted** it.
sentences.translation: Eshikka tegmang — uni **hozirgina bo'yadim**.

sentences.text: **Has** the film **just started**, or have we missed the beginning?
sentences.translation: Film **endigina boshlandimi** yoki boshini o'tkazib yubordikmi?

sentences.text: My sister **has just had** a baby girl, so I'm an aunt now!
sentences.translation: Opam **endigina** qizcha **ko'rdi**, endi men xolaman!

sentences.text: Take your umbrella — it**'s just started** to rain quite heavily.
sentences.translation: Soyaboningni ol — yomg'ir **endigina** ancha kuchli **yog'a boshladi**.

sentences.text: James **has just come** back from Japan, and he's still jet-lagged.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Yaponiyadan **endigina qaytdi**, hali ham vaqt farqiga ko'nikolmayapti.

sentences.text: Our manager **has just told** us that the office will close early today.
sentences.translation: Menejerimiz bugun ofis erta yopilishini bizga **hozirgina aytdi**.

examples.title: **already**: sooner than expected
examples.description: already — allaqachon, kutilganidan oldin: have + already + V3 yoki gap oxirida. O'zbekchada «allaqachon», «-ib bo'ldi».

sentences.text: Don't buy any bread — I**'ve already bought** two loaves.
sentences.translation: Non olma — men **allaqachon** ikkita non **olib qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: Kate **has already read** the book, so she knows how it ends.
sentences.translation: Keyt kitobni **allaqachon o'qib chiqqan**, shuning uchun oxirini biladi.

sentences.text: It's only ten o'clock, and Aziz **has already drunk** four cups of coffee.
sentences.translation: Soat endi o'n, Aziz esa **allaqachon** to'rt piyola qahva **ichib bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Is Dilnoza still at work? — No, she**'s already gone** home.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza hali ishdami? — Yo'q, u **allaqachon uyga ketdi**.

sentences.text: We**'ve already spent** half our holiday budget, and it's only Tuesday!
sentences.translation: Ta'til byudjetimizning yarmini **allaqachon sarflab bo'ldik**, bugun esa endi seshanba!

sentences.text: **Have** you **finished** already? That was quick!
sentences.translation: **Tugatib bo'ldingizmi**? Juda tez-ku!

sentences.text: The tickets for the concert in Manchester **have already sold** out.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi konsert chiptalari **allaqachon sotilib bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: You don't need to explain — Jasur **has already told** me everything.
sentences.translation: Tushuntirishing shart emas — Jasur menga hammasini **aytib bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: I**'ve already seen** this episode twice, so let's watch something else.
sentences.translation: Bu qismni **allaqachon** ikki marta **ko'rganman**, boshqa narsa ko'raylik.

sentences.text: Oliver **has already found** a new job, although he only left the old one last week.
sentences.translation: Oliver eski ishidan o'tgan haftadagina ketgan bo'lsa ham, **allaqachon** yangi ish **topib oldi**.

examples.title: **yet**: questions and negatives
examples.description: yet — so'roqda «...mi? (hali)», inkorda «hali ... -gani yo'q». yet gap oxirida turadi.

sentences.text: **Have** you **booked** the hotel yet? — Not yet, I'm still comparing prices.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonani **bron qildingizmi**? — Hali yo'q, narxlarni solishtiryapman.

sentences.text: I **haven't decided** yet what to study at university.
sentences.translation: Universitetda nima o'qishni **hali hal qilganim yo'q**.

sentences.text: **Has** the parcel from London **arrived** yet? I ordered it two weeks ago.
sentences.translation: Londondan posilka **keldimi**? Ikki hafta oldin buyurtma qilgandim.

sentences.text: The doctors **haven't found** the cause of the problem yet.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar muammoning sababini **hali topishgani yo'q**.

sentences.text: Don't call Madina — she **hasn't woken up** yet after her night shift.
sentences.translation: Madinaga qo'ng'iroq qilma — tungi smenadan keyin **hali uyg'ongani yo'q**.

sentences.text: **Have** they **fixed** the lift yet, or are we still using the stairs?
sentences.translation: Liftni **tuzatishdimi** yoki hali ham zinadan foydalanyapmizmi?

sentences.text: We **haven't paid** the electricity bill yet — can you remind me tomorrow?
sentences.translation: Elektr uchun **hali to'laganimiz yo'q** — ertaga eslatib qo'ya olasanmi?

sentences.text: Sarah **hasn't replied** to my message yet, which is unusual for her.
sentences.translation: Sara xabarimga **hali javob bermadi**, bu unga xos emas.

sentences.text: **Has** Bekzod **told** his parents about the new job yet?
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi ishi haqida ota-onasiga **aytdimi**?

sentences.text: The new metro station **hasn't opened** yet, but they say it will be ready in spring.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro bekati **hali ochilgani yo'q**, lekin bahorda tayyor bo'lar ekan.

examples.title: **gone** or **been**?
examples.description: has gone to — ketgan va hali o'sha yerda (bu yerda yo'q); has been to — borib kelgan, qaytgan. been — tajriba ma'nosida ham keladi (→ 8-dars).

sentences.text: Where's Tom? — He**'s gone** to the bank, but he'll be back soon.
sentences.translation: Tom qani? — Bankka **ketdi**, lekin tez orada qaytadi.

sentences.text: Tom **has been** to the bank, so now he has some cash.
sentences.translation: Tom bankka **borib keldi**, endi uning yonida naqd pul bor.

sentences.text: My parents **have gone** to Mecca for the Hajj, so I'm looking after the house.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Hajga **ketishgan**, shuning uchun uyga men qarab turibman.

sentences.text: Nilufar **has been** to Istanbul three times, so she knows the best places.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Istanbulga uch marta **borib kelgan**, shuning uchun eng yaxshi joylarni biladi.

sentences.text: Have you ever **been** to Edinburgh during the festival?
sentences.translation: Hech festival paytida Edinburgda **bo'lganmisiz**?

sentences.text: Everyone **has gone** home — you're the last person in the office.
sentences.translation: Hamma uyga **ketib bo'ldi** — ofisda oxirgi odam sizsiz.

sentences.text: Where **have** you **been**? Your shoes are covered in mud!
sentences.translation: Qayerda **eding**? Poyabzaling loyga belanib ketibdi-ku!

sentences.text: Aziz isn't here — he**'s gone** to Samarkand for a conference.
sentences.translation: Aziz bu yerda yo'q — konferensiya uchun Samarqandga **ketgan**.

sentences.text: **Has** Emma ever **been** to Uzbekistan? — No, but she really wants to go.
sentences.translation: Emma hech O'zbekistonda **bo'lganmi**? — Yo'q, lekin borishni juda xohlaydi.

sentences.text: The children **have gone** to their grandparents' for the summer, so the house is very quiet.
sentences.translation: Bolalar yozga bobo-buvisinikiga **ketishgan**, shuning uchun uy juda jimjit.

examples.title: Dialogue: getting ready for a trip
examples.description: Safarga tayyorgarlik: nima qilindi, nima hali qilinmadi — just, already, yet bilan Present Perfect suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Are you ready for tomorrow, Aziz? **Have** you **packed** yet?
sentences.translation: — Ertangi kunga tayyormisan, Aziz? Narsalaringni **yig'dingmi**?

sentences.text: — Almost. I**'ve packed** my clothes, but I **haven't found** my passport yet.
sentences.translation: — Deyarli. Kiyimlarimni **joyladim**, lekin pasportimni **hali topganim yo'q**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! **Have** you **looked** in the drawer by the door?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Eshik yonidagi tortmaga **qaradingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, and I**'ve** already **checked** all my jacket pockets too.
sentences.translation: — Ha, kurtkamning hamma cho'ntaklarini ham **tekshirib chiqdim**.

sentences.text: — Wait, here it is! You**'ve left** it on the kitchen table.
sentences.translation: — To'xta, mana u! Uni oshxona stolida **qoldiribsan**.

sentences.text: — Thank goodness! **Has** the taxi company **sent** the confirmation?
sentences.translation: — Xayriyat! Taksi kompaniyasi tasdiqni **yubordimi**?

sentences.text: — They**'ve just sent** a text: the driver will come at five.
sentences.translation: — **Hozirgina** xabar **yuborishdi**: haydovchi soat beshda keladi.

sentences.text: — Great. **Have** you **told** your boss that you'll be away?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Boshlig'ingga yo'qligingni **aytdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Of course. I**'ve** even **finished** the report he asked for.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. U so'ragan hisobotni ham **tugatib qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: — Then you**'ve done** everything! Now go to bed — it's nearly midnight.
sentences.translation: — Unda hammasini **qilib bo'libsan**! Endi uxla — yarim tun bo'lib qoldi.

examples.title: Mixed: news, results and unfinished tasks
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: hozirgi natija, yangilik, just / already / yet, gone / been — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The government **has announced** free English courses for teachers, and thousands **have** already **applied**.
sentences.translation: Hukumat o'qituvchilar uchun bepul ingliz tili kurslarini **e'lon qildi**, minglab kishilar **allaqachon ariza topshirdi**.

sentences.text: I**'ve read** the first two chapters, but I **haven't started** the third one yet.
sentences.translation: Dastlabki ikki bobni **o'qib chiqdim**, lekin uchinchisini **hali boshlaganim yo'q**.

sentences.text: Someone **has taken** my umbrella, and it's pouring outside!
sentences.translation: Kimdir soyabonimni **olib ketibdi**, tashqarida esa jala quyyapti!

sentences.text: **Has** anyone **seen** the remote control? It**'s disappeared** again.
sentences.translation: Pultni hech kim **ko'rmadimi**? U yana **g'oyib bo'libdi**.

sentences.text: Kate **has gone** to Oxford for an interview, so she can't come to the meeting.
sentences.translation: Keyt suhbatga Oksfordga **ketgan**, shuning uchun yig'ilishga kela olmaydi.

sentences.text: Thanks to the new road, the journey to Fergana **has become** much shorter.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l tufayli Farg'onaga safar ancha **qisqardi**.

sentences.text: We**'ve just moved** into a new flat, and we **haven't unpacked** our boxes yet.
sentences.translation: **Endigina** yangi kvartiraga **ko'chib o'tdik**, qutilarimizni esa **hali ochganimiz yo'q**.

sentences.text: Why **haven't** you **answered** my emails? I**'ve sent** you three already!
sentences.translation: Nega xatlarimga **javob bermading**? Senga allaqachon uchta **yubordim**!

sentences.text: The company **has lost** its biggest client, so everyone is worried about their jobs.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya eng yirik mijozini **yo'qotdi**, shuning uchun hamma ishidan xavotirda.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has been** to the dentist, and her tooth doesn't hurt any more.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza tish shifokoriga **borib keldi**, endi tishi og'rimayapti.
